Reality Fracture will take us into his Echoverse, confront his plans and twisted past, and change Magic forever. It's all been leading up to this: the start of Reality Fracture 's story on August 31, 2026, available on DailyMTG and The Magic Story Podcast . But what is the Echoverse? What is Hexhaven Academy? And why, after years of attempting to save the Multiverse, has Jace Beleren turned heel? To help prepare you for this monumental moment in Magic 's narrative, we've compiled the Planeswalker's Guide to Reality Fracture . Some of your questions will be answered today. As for the rest? You'll have to read the story to find the answers. Follow the story of Reality Fracture when the first episode releases on August 31! Reality Fracture releases on October 2, 2026, and is available for preorder now from your local game store , TCGplayer , Amazon , and elsewhere Magic is sold. Traveling between worlds is nothing new to a Planeswalker. The thrill of setting foot on a new plane never goes away. But it is rare, nearly unheard of, to step into an alternate reality. Here in one of the many memory-prisons inside the tower is the part of Jace that is honest about himself. He stands in the imaginary ruins of his former sanctum within the Chamber of the Guildpact. Over and over, I have. But as time wore on—as we fought murderous villains and devastating disasters without end—we had a thought . An experiment ignited by our trauma after the Phyrexian Invasion of the entire Multiverse: What if these monsters never existed at all? What if there was a version of the Multiverse where no one had to suffer, or lose friends, or be shaped into an abomination against their will? There are no Eldrazi here. Their corruption never touched soil or souls. There are no Phyrexians. Our bodies are ours and ours alone. There is no Bolas here. Our destinies are not determined by a self-serving egoist but a benevolent thinker. What started as a noble idea has become a nightmare. summary_original: This year we have returned to Melbourne Victoria for the first time since 2017!! On the Friday we had 115 players for the Genesys championship playing 8 rounds with 2 to go on the Sunday On Saturday for the Constructed Event, we had 299 turn up all trying to place in the top 2 to represent Oceania for the World Championship Series to be held in Japan in September. Duelists have come from across the country and over from New Zealand having practiced a ton in the weeks leading up to it and are hungry for that invitation. This is the second event under the new rules where only the top 8 players after 12 rounds of Swiss. It will be a challenging feat no doubt but some players dabbled into the Genesys event and if are doing well in one but not the other can opt to play the other on the Sunday. This is incredibly exciting for players with two major tournaments to show off their dueling capabilities and what a weekend it will be. After 2 long days of Dueling we have finally crowned our 2 participants who will represent Oceania at the World Championship Series in Japan later this year. From Sydney we have Jerry Zhang piloting his 60 card deck which was an amalgamation of powerful prominent archetypes from the lasts 2 years including Mitsurugi, Fiendsmith, Yummy and the newly released Light and Darkness Ritual. From Melbourne we have Dillon Taylor playing his Artmage Power Patron deck. He attributes his success to winning 13 out of 15 die rolls and hopes he can carry his luck with his knowledge and skills to a placement at the world championships. They played it out for the title of Oceanic Champion with Dillion winning game 1 after using his deck to amass a powerful field. Jerry brings it to a tie in game 2 using his powerfully synergistic monsters. In the third game Dillon was unable to open as well as he would like with a modest field protected by Solemn Judgment and Solemn Accusation however after using them both he was left on just a measly 1000 Life Points allowing Jerry to close out the game and take the match. summary_original: Once every year, Duelists gather at both the European and Oceanic World Championship Qualifier events to compete not just for the coveted title of Champion – but also to determine who will represent their region at the most prestigious of all Yu‑Gi‑Oh! tournaments: the World Championship Series. As we approach this year’s WCS in Tokyo, we also look ahead to the upcoming 2027 season – as we would like to give you notice of some changes to the European and Oceanic World Championship Qualification structure. For the 2027 World Championship Season, starting with Chaos Origins OTS Championships, Regional Qualifiers, and OPEN events, there will be some adjustments to how qualifications will be earned. Old invite structure: 1 invite per 8 participants (rounded up) – uncapped New invite structure: 1 invite per 8 Duelists (rounded up) – capped at 64 invites* *For European WCQ Regions, the amount of WQP awarded to the highest ranked Duelist will also be 64, with 63 points for second, 62 points for third, and so on forth. This change is focused towards the World Qualifying Points program. When reviewing how Duelists have earned World Qualifying points, we identified that some events falling under the 1 invite per 8 Duelist structure were outpacing events such as Yu‑Gi‑Oh! Championship Series events – despite having significantly less Duelists competing at the event. National/State Championships and Yu‑Gi‑Oh! Championship Series remain unchanged. The final change relates to the World Qualifying Points in Europe. While previously you were able to earn points over an unlimited number of events, for the 2027 Season, only your top 12 finishes throughout the season will count toward your point total. In the event that Duelists are tied, the highest point total earned at a single event will be used as a tie-breaker, followed by the second best finish. If all best 12 finishes are tied, events beyond the 12 best finishes will be used as a tie breaker. In the event all standings are equal, a play-off will take place at the 2027 World Championship Qualifier. Just a few weeks ago, during the Galactic Championship, we unveiled the first look at Homeworlds , the exciting next set of the Star Wars ™: Unlimited trading card game. In that first look, we showed off some of the new elements introduced in the set, including a pair of new Spotlight Decks that will release alongside it. These pre-built, ready-to-play decks feature Chewbacca and Grand Moff Tarkin as leaders, and they're here to welcome in the new set by embodying Homeworlds ' themes and mechanics. As with all Spotlight Decks , these decks include cards from older sets mixed in with the new ones to help create a more optimized, unpack-and-play experience for anyone who wants to pick one up. Today, we're taking a deeper dive at all the new cards you can find in the Homeworlds Spotlight Decks , so without further ado, let's start with a look at Tarkin! Cold, calculating, and ruthless, Grand Moff Tarkin ( Homeworlds , 4) enters the set as a Vigilance and Villainy leader. His playstyle revolves around the new Fortify keyword, which allows you to attach an upgrade to your base instead of one of your units. Since Tarkin's ability allows you to ignore the aspect penalties of Fortify upgrades you play, you can stack a big pile of these fortifications onto your base throughout the game. This is something you'll absolutely want to do, since it will take you a while to build up to the 9 resources you need to deploy your leader unit, which is not Tarkin himself, but rather the terrifying Death Star! Arriving on the scene as the game's first true “space leader,” the Death Star is a horrifyingly powerful unit that can instantly defeat an enemy base with 10 or less remaining HP. summary_original: Reality itself is coming undone. Jace Beleren has turned his vision of a perfected Multiverse into a reality— his reality. The Echoverse: a world free of Nicol Bolas, the Eldrazi, and Phyrexia. As Jace's creation takes shape and threatens to overtake the Multiverse we know, his former allies must face him head-on. Welcome to Reality Fracture , where Jace's solution is everyone's problem. Reality Fracture will take you into the Echoverse for the epic conclusion of the latest arc of Magic Story , where you can confront Jace's twisted world or join him as a student of Hexhaven. Jace has taken on a new identity as the Theorist, presiding over the Echoverse as the all-seeing architect of its reality. But the Multiverse—and especially Chandra Nalaar—won't go down without a fight. Discover what lies at the heart of the Echoverse when Reality Fracture releases worldwide on October 2, 2026. The set is available for preorder now from your local game store , TCGplayer , Amazon , and elsewhere Magic is sold. It's a collision of Multiverses, the conclusion to years of storytelling, and the culmination of years of Magic history, both in-universe and outside of it. Here, you'll encounter twisted versions of the characters and cards you love, transformed into something new, something that better suits Jace's vision. But you'll also see the Multiverse you know with echoed pairs. Every Reality Fracture Play Booster and Collector Booster contains an echoed pair. One card represents our Multiverse and the other represents the Echoverse. Each echoed pair (with one exception) depicts the same character, showing you how their life could have gone in Jace's reality. You'll find echoed pairs of planeswalkers, legendary creatures, and a few other surprises. We'll showcase more echoed pairs closer to the set's debut. For now, we look forward to reading your theories about which characters you expect to see in the Echoverse. Reality Fracture releases on October 2, 2026, and is available for preorder now from your local game store , TCGplayer , Amazon , and elsewhere Magic is sold. Jace has come a long way from Vryn, spreading his influence across the entirety of this set and its narrative.

summary_original: There's nothing quite like Magic: The Gathering . We've got the best fans in the world, and they love to gather for the greatest game in the world. That's why we're declaring 2027 as the Year of the Gathering, where we'll give you plenty of places to gather, ways to gather, and most importantly, reasons to gather and celebrate the releases you love. Today is all about next year's trips into the Magic Multiverse, where we're making long-awaited returns to worlds you love and taking you to all-new corners of our Multiverse. First, 2027 will feature three Magic Multiverse sets and three Universes Beyond sets, alternating between the two. This is the balance we're looking for after the transition year that was 2026. We know how much players love the Magic Multiverse—and so do we! How can you not love a place where a rebellious pyromancer can team up with a leonin warrior to put a stop to a mind-mage's hubris? (Can you tell we're excited for Reality Fracture ?) And the Magic Multiverse sets for next year are truly something special. These are releases you'll want to celebrate, and we cannot wait to introduce you to new worlds and welcome you back to old favorites. Speaking of how we plan to celebrate those sets, Magic is going even more global with four MagicCons in 2027 , including our first MagicCon in Japan! That means more chances to meet up with your fellow Magic fans, collect signatures, and experience the bafflingly chaotic fun that is drafting Mystery Booster Commander Edition (which we'll share more about at Gen Con). But we've stalled for long enough. We know what you're especially interested in. Where are we headed next year? Our first set of the year will take us to a brand-new plane, one that players have asked about for years. It's time to dive into … An endless ocean. Vast cities beneath the waves. Gods that command the currents as they swim alongside their followers. This is Nauctis, a plane rich with brine and opportunities for adventure. summary: Od svého vydání v roce 2022 je karetní hra ONE PIECE podporována hráči po celém světě a nyní vstupuje do třetího roku. Naše ambice zůstávají od začátku nezměněny: ve spolupráci s vámi, našimi fanoušky a také našimi poskytovateli licencí, chceme podporovat prostředí, které nám všem umožní zažít a oslavit velkolepý svět ONE PIECE zobrazený v karetní hře. Svět karetních her spoléhá na nadšení a účast fanoušků. Potvrdili jsme však případy, kdy jsou produkty, které neoprávněně kopírují nebo napodobují návrhy karet z karetní hry ONE PIECE, prodávány nebo distribuovány na stránkách elektronického obchodu, na místech konání akcí a na podobných místech. Jsme odhodláni společně s vámi všemi vytvořit vzrušující svět karetní hry ONE PIECE a zároveň neseme odpovědnost za respektování a náležité zacházení s veškerým duševním vlastnictvím spojeným s franšízou ONE PIECE. Tento respekt a vhodné zacházení jsou nezbytné pro zajištění zachování franšízy ONE PIECE pro budoucnost. Proto požadujeme, abyste dodržovali následující předpisy, které se vztahují na karetní hru ONE PIECE Card Game: ・Žádné karty, příslušenství nebo jiné zboží odvozené nebo zkopírované z návrhů karet vydaných nebo prodaných společností Bandai bez povolení nesmí být prodáváno ani distribuováno. ・Žádné karty, doplňky nebo jiné zboží, které obsahuje znaky nebo podobné aspekty související s franšízou ONE PIECE bez povolení, nesmějí být prodávány ani distribuovány. Neautorizované produkty, jak je popsáno výše, nebudou povoleny na oficiálních turnajích ONE PIECE karetních her a akcích, které se mají konat v budoucnu. *Tyto předpisy neznamenají formální povolení nebo souhlas, ani nefungují jako vzdání se jakýchkoli zákonných práv. Tyto předpisy mohou být upraveny podle našeho uvážení s ohledem na právní omezení a skutečné okolnosti.
summary_original: Since its release in 2022, the ONE PIECE Card Game has been supported by players around the world and is now entering its third year. Our ambition remains unchanged from the beginning: working together with you, our fans, as well as our licensors, we want to foster an environment that enables all of us to experience and celebrate the spectacular world of ONE PIECE portrayed within a card game. The world of card games relies on the enthusiasm and participation of the fans. However, we have confirmed cases where products that unauthorizedly replicate or imitate card designs from the ONE PIECE Card Game are being sold or distributed on e-commerce sites, at event venues, and similar locations. We are committed to creating an exciting world of the ONE PIECE Card Game together with all of you, while also bearing the responsibility to respect and appropriately handle all intellectual property associated with the ONE PIECE franchise. This respect and appropriate handling are necessary to ensure the ONE PIECE franchise is preserved for the future. Therefore, we require that you adhere to the following regulations as they apply to the ONE PIECE Card Game: ・No cards, accessory items, or other goods derived from or copied from card designs released or sold by Bandai without authorization may be sold or distributed. ・No cards, accessory items, or other goods that incorporate characters or similar aspects related to the ONE PIECE franchise without authorization are to be sold or distributed Unauthorised products as described above will not be permitted at official ONE PIECE Card Game tournaments and events scheduled to be held in the future. *These regulations do not signify formal permission or consent, nor do they operate as a waiver of any legal rights. These regulations are subject to modification at our discretion, taking into account legal constraints and actual circumstances.

summary_original: WINDSOR, UNITED KINGDOM – July 2, 2026 – Konami Digital Entertainment, B.V. (KONAMI) launches Chaos Origins for the Yu‑Gi‑Oh! TRADING CARD GAME (TCG). Introduced in this booster set is the new visual update to Starlight Rares as they now produce richer colours and replace the grey outer card border with a rainbow foil border. This 100-card booster set also reimagines monsters like Black Luster Soldier and Magician of Black Chaos , with powerful new effects designed to compete in today’s tournaments and adds five frame-breaking extended art cards. New versions of Yugi’s most famous monsters make a re-appearance with new effects as well such as Summoned Skull , Celtic Guardian and Kuriboh . Also returning in this set is the Sacred Beasts from the original storyline of Yu‑Gi‑Oh! GX. These new versions of the Sacred Beasts cannot be Summoned except by a “Sacred Beast” card effect which multiple duplicates are included in this set making it easier to Summon them. Each also has improved versions of their original powers. Alongside the Sacred Beasts, the core “Blitzclique” monsters also receive updated effects with a brand-new theme of Thunder scavengers. Furthermore, a chess theme has been dedicated to this booster set centred around the King of Games. A rare theme as this chess concept has no Main Deck monsters but rather Spells, Traps and Synchro Monsters and relies on Duelists to place their Monster cards into the Spell & Trap Zones. summary_original: More extended art cards, chibi cards and blinged-out upgrades to make your Deck as glorious as it can be! WINDSOR, UNITED KINGDOM – June 4th, 2026 – Konami Digital Entertainment, B.V. (KONAMI) launches Battles of Legend: Glorious Gallery for the Yu‑Gi‑Oh! TRADING CARD GAME (TCG). More variant art cards are introduced in Battles of Legend: Glorious Gallery as well as dozens of brand-new cards. Following the success of Rarity Collection 5’s extended art cards, Battles of Legend: Glorious Gallery adds 10 more including Dragon Master Magia, Red Supernova Dragon , and Dominus Impulse . All are available in Ultra Rare and Starlight Rare versions. Battles of Legend also presents 10 chibi variant art cards that includes Dark Magician Girl , Tour Guide From the Underworld , Evolzar Laggia , Legendary Six Samurai – Shi En , Vampire Lord , and Summoned Skull . All cards are fully playable versions of those monsters with even a chibi version of Exodia, the Forbidden Once . As every Battles of Legend pack is all-foil (4 Ultra Rares + 1 Secret Rare), many cards are included as foils for the first time. Increased chances of previously hard-to-get foils such as El Shaddoll Anoyatyllis , Shooting Majestic Star Dragon , the trio of Adreus , Keeper of Armageddon , Armades , Keeper of Boundaries , and Tiras , Keeper of Genesis , and many more are also available. Duelists can enhance their strategies as Battles of Legend: Glorious Gallery also brings 40 new cards for a variety of Decks, from “Shaddoll” and “Tellarknight” to “Junk” monsters “Endymion”. summary: Soutěžte v kvalifikacích SPEED DUEL a RUSH DUEL a zajistěte si účast na prestižním Yu-Gi-Oh! summary_original: Compete in both SPEED DUEL and RUSH DUEL qualifiers and secure attendance at the prestigious Yu‑Gi‑Oh! World Championship 2026 in Tokyo WINDSOR, UNITED KINGDOM – May 11th, 2026 – Konami Digital Entertainment, B.V. (KONAMI) announces today that Road to Worlds Campaign begins in Yu‑Gi‑Oh! DUEL LINKS, inviting Duelists to qualify for the esteemed Yu‑Gi‑Oh! World Championship 2026 (WCS) and contend for the title. Commemorating the start of the qualifiers, Yu‑Gi‑Oh! DUEL LINKS also launches a two-part campaign packed with special rewards ahead of dedicated SPEED DUEL and RUSH DUEL qualifiers. The qualifiers will be held across both categories in two stages guaranteeing engaging and intense Duels. Achieving a high‑rank in either qualifier will allow a select number of Duelists to qualify for the WCS, held in Tokyo, Japan with a chance to become world champion. Yu‑Gi‑Oh! DUEL LINKS celebrates the qualifiers with an in-game campaign, offering new cards for Duelists in SPEED DUEL and RUSH DUEL. Simply logging in during the campaign period will reward Duelists with Crimson Dragon (SPEED / Prismatic) and other special rewards such as a free SPEED DUEL Structure Deck. Duelist can also obtain Dark Magician (RUSH /Alternate Art / Prismatic / OR Style), Dark Magician Girl (RUSH / Alternate Art / Prismatic / OR Style) and a free RUSH DUEL Structure Deck. *Please note, these prizes are offered in different periods. To get more campaign details and periods, please check the in-game notification. The campaign will also feature daily login bonuses and Event Missions with incentives. DUEL LINKS offers two new BOXES from each date. RUSH DUEL will receive RUSH Mini BOX Eternal Genesis today whereas SPEED DUEL offers Main BOX Red Supernova from May 21st. title: Zakázané/omezené karty platné od 10. dubna 2026
title_original: Banned/Restricted Cards effective from April 10, 2026
summary: V rámci našeho závazku udržovat vyvážené soutěžní prostředí přidáváme a odstraňujeme následující karty ze seznamu zakázaných/omezených karet s platností od 10. dubna 2026. My, vývojový tým ONE PIECE CARD GAME, považujeme za hlavní zásadu pro navrhování her, aby si hráči a fanoušci mohli užít četné balíčky postavené na kartě vůdce. V průběhu roku nepřetržitě monitorujeme herní prostředí, abychom zajistili zachování strategické rozmanitosti, vždy zvažujeme, zda jsou nutné revize seznamu zakázaných/omezených karet. Při rozhodování, zda přidat karty na seznam zakázaných/omezených karet, vyhodnotíme několik aspektů balíčku – například míru výher, výsledky z velkých turnajů, míru využití, předpokládaný vliv na budoucí herní prostředí a zda omezuje životaschopnost ostatních vůdců. Z tohoto důvodu také zvažujeme odstranění určitých karet ze seznamu zakázaných/omezených, když se změní herní prostředí a když věříme, že si hráči a fanoušci budou moci znovu naplno užít hru bez těchto omezení. Obvykle oznamujeme revize seznamu jednou po skončení sezóny mistrovství 1 v Japonsku a jednou po mistrovství světa. Pokud však zjistíme, že nám určitá karta brání v poskytování příjemného prostředí, můžeme ji přidat na seznam zakázaných/omezených, aniž bychom čekali na konec sezóny mistrovství. Vezměte prosím na vědomí, že tato aktualizace bude vynucena od 10. dubna v NA/EU/LATAM/OC a datum implementace se bude lišit od jiných regionů včetně Japonska.​ Kartu A a kartu B nelze zahrnout do stejného balíčku.​ Tato kombinace karet byla použita v širší škále balíčků, zejména těch včetně žluté, než jsme původně předpokládali.​ V důsledku toho jsme zaznamenali, že herní doba se výrazně prodloužila, než jsme se rozhodli poskytnout, což jsme se rozhodli poskytnout.​ označte tuto kombinaci jako zakázaný pár. Abychom si udrželi příjemný herní zážitek s obrovskou rozmanitostí balíčků pro všechny hráče a fanoušky, nadále sledujeme herní prostředí a v případě potřeby provádíme revize.
summary_original: As part of our commitment to maintaining a balanced competitive environment, we are adding and removing the following cards from the Banned/Restricted Card List, effective April 10, 2026. We, the Development Team of ONE PIECE CARD GAME, consider as the main policy for game designing that the players and fans can enjoy numerous decks built around the leader card. Throughout the year, we continuously monitor the game environment to ensure strategic diversity is maintained, always considering whether revisions to the Banned/Restricted Card List are necessary. When determining whether to add cards to the Banned/Restricted List, we evaluate multiple aspects of a deck—such as its win rate, results from major tournaments, usage rate, its projected influence on the future game environment, and whether it restricts the viability of other Leaders. For that reason, we also consider removing certain cards from the Banned/Restricted List when the game environment changes, and when we believe players and fans will once again be able to fully enjoy the game without those restrictions. Typically, we announce revisions to the list once after the conclusion of Championship Season 1 in Japan, and once after the World Championship. However, if we determine that a particular card is preventing us from providing an enjoyable environment, we may add it to the Banned/Restricted List without waiting for the end of a Championship season. Please note that this update will be enforced starting April 10 in NA/EU/LATAM/OC, and the implementation date will differ from other regions including Japan.​ Card A and Card B cannot be included in the same deck.​ This card combination has been used in a wider variety of decks, particularly those including Yellow, than we initially anticipated.​ As a result, we have observed that game times have become significantly longer than expected, which deviates from the gameplay experience we aim to provide.​ Therefore, we have decided to designate this combination as a banned pair .
